youtube.aciklama: In Kattah and colleagues' 2009 study of 101 patients, HINTS separated strokes with 100 percent sensitivity and about 96 percent specificity, while the first diffusion MRI missed eight strokes confirmed later. But the exam was done by an experienced neuro-ophthalmologist in high-risk patients; HINTS does not diagnose, and any central sign calls for emergency physician evaluation.
